title.narrative: HCFC Phase out management plan (Stage I)

description.narrative: The purpose of this project is to develop the first stage of the Compliance Strategy and its corresponding Action Plan for the phase out of the Annex C Group I controlled substances (HCFCs) of the Montreal Protocol, for the period up to year 2020, which includes the freezing in 2013, the first reduction of the 10% from the baseline by 2015, and the second reduction of 35% from the baseline by 2020. .
